_about: PARKED. The pulse clashes and the three beam answers of ../m0-rich.md (its waves 4 and 7; the EP's wave 5). Not loaded, not hashed. The pulse numbers and the answers' rules are Game Design's and are quoted, not set, here.

pulse.tie: the scores differ by less than 10: both are thrown back, nobody wins the exchange, mood +8
pulse.start: the score starts from state (tier, ki, meters), as the clash does today
pulse.ai: hits 40, 65 or 85 in 100 pulses (easy, medium, hard)
pulse.budget: one big set piece every 20 s; a second inside it plays as its ordinary version

clashes.name: Fist clash
clashes.trigger: a heavy meets a heavy (the HEAVY CLASH template), when the set-piece budget allows
clashes.ordinary: today's HEAVY CLASH: won, countered or the shockwave, with no pulses
clashes.distance: the longer of the two heavies' contact distances (wave 1); each striking limb is solved onto the other's striking limb

composed.opens: each fighter's own heavy opener: 10 to choose from
composed.resolves: the winner's blow goes through as an ender (the same piece, at full blow weight) and launches by its hint

clashes.between: the strain: Animation blends pressing and giving by the running score; each surge drives the pair up to 6 u toward the loser's side
clashes.onAPulse: a ring from the meeting point; from tier 3 it damages structures, inside the collateral budgets

poses.look: The two blows have met and stopped: his limb straight behind the point of contact, shoulder and back leg in one line with it, the other arm wide for balance.
Winning: his weight is over the front leg, the limb driving through, his head lowered past the meeting point.
Losing: bent back at the waist, the front knee folding, the limb collapsing toward his own chest.

clashes._legal: no cracked-sky or shattered-space effect; the lock is a strain in motion, never a freeze frame on two locked fists

clashes.name: Blur exchange
clashes.trigger: both attacking with strings queued, in Tense or Frenzied, at tier 2 or above, when the budget allows
clashes.ordinary: the two strings resolve as ordinary exchanges, one after the other
clashes.distance: each blow at its own contact distance; the pair travels about 6 bh a burst along a level line clear of structures

composed.blows: nine alternating lights (five for the one who started, four for the other) and three pulse blows each, all from the light pool: 16 to choose from, no key strike twice
composed.resolves: the winner's ender lands at 84, after a 12-tick wind-up, and launches

clashes.between: the alternating lights; on each pulse both strike at once and the press decides whose blow gets through
clashes.onAPulse: the blow that got through snaps the other's head or body by the computed reaction; no ring
clashes.damage: PROPOSAL for Game Design: each traded light does x0.5 of a light, since both sides land them

poses.look: Travelling forward while striking: hips square to the line of travel, the body leaning into it, the rear leg trailing straight.
Travelling backward while striking: weight on the back hip, the chin tucked, the lead arm already returning to guard.

clashes._legal: the bodies stay readable: every blow is a drawn contact pose held 4 ticks or more; never invisible fighters with only shock rings; no freeze on locked fists; no cut to an onlooker who cannot follow

clashes.name: Grapple lock
clashes.trigger: two grabs meet in the air, or a dive grab meets a grab; rare (under one a match)
clashes.ordinary: none: two grabs that meet are always the lock
clashes.distance: 36 u, the hold's distance (wave 4); each is held by the other

composed.resolves: the winner throws the loser down: the drive down, or the spike with one arm

clashes.between: the strain: the pair turns a quarter turn about the grip and sinks about 1 bh over the lock
clashes.onAPulse: a wrench: the surging fighter turns the other's shoulders a step further

poses.look: A collar-and-elbow tie-up: one hand behind the rival's neck plate, the other on the elbow, foreheads close, backs flat.
Winning: he has driven over the top, the rival's head under his shoulder, his hips high.
Losing: folded under, one knee dropping, his grip sliding from the collar to the forearm.
With a broken arm: the forearm guard of the good arm across the collar, his shoulder set against the rival's chest.

clashes._legal: Combat's proposal: a collar-and-elbow tie-up only; never hands locked palm to palm with fingers laced, and never arms raised overhead in a test of strength

beamAnswers.source: docs/design/rule-of-cool.md section 2; control-rules.md section 1; the live beam.outcomeByProfile.dynamic rule DEFLECT
beamAnswers.trigger: a perfect block against a signature: a fresh Guard press in the last 10 ticks of its tell. The direction held on that press picks the look
beamAnswers.reward: no damage, no ki cost, +8 ki; no stagger and no riposte. The walk through leaves the attacker 20 ticks into recovery

ticks.hold: as long as the beam lasts

looks.sim: the beam is turned aside and carves where the game sends it; the damage counts against the beam's tier cap and is credited to him
poses: in: side-on, the plated forearm drawn across his chest
hold: the forearm swept out to full length, the whole body turned with it, the beam bending off the plate
out: the arm still out, the head already turned back to the rival
looks._legal: Combat's proposal: the forearm guard does it, with the whole body turning: not a casual flick of one hand, and not an open palm held out against the beam

looks.sim: the beam parts round him and scars the ground on both sides behind him
poses: in: he turns side-on, the plated shoulder and spine to the beam
hold: leaning into it on the plates, head turned away, hands open at his chest
out: he straightens and turns back, plates smoking in his own violet
looks._legal: Combat's proposal: no arms crossed in front of him as a block; it parts on the shoulder and spine

looks.sim: he advances through the beam and arrives at contact distance in front of the attacker, who is 20 ticks into recovery
poses: in: upright, chin level, hands open and low
stride: one unhurried step, mirrored for the next, the beam breaking round his chest
arrive: stopped at arm's length, weight even, looking at the rival
looks._legal: Combat's proposal: hands open and low: no palm held out against the beam, no arms crossed, no clenched fists; no line shouted as he walks

beamAnswers._legal: Legal (rule-of-cool.md section 3b, feature 16): no named technique and no borrowed hand pose; a swatted beam does not end in a mushroom cloud staged like a known scene

sim: a beat op `pulse` that opens a window and reads the press
the running clash score as readable state or an event per pulse
a strike target that is the rival's striking limb
the held state both ways for the grapple lock
an `answer` on the DEFLECT outcome: swat, split or walk, from the direction held
